更多介绍More about my research

PhD student in Artificial Intelligence at the National University of Singapore, supervised by Prof. Mengling Feng.

My research focuses on recursive self-improvement (RSI) for coding agents and foundation-model post-training: turning autonomous exploration, code execution, and verifiable feedback into scalable learning signals that advance reasoning and long-horizon capabilities.

My doctoral research centers on AI recursive self-improvement (RSI), alongside medical agents and medical AI safety, advancing both AI capabilities and human wellbeing.

I am currently a foundation-model post-training research intern at Zhipu AI (Z.ai), driving post-training with RSI for coding agents. I have also been selected for the Qwen foundation-model internship (Alibaba Tongyi) and for Tencent’s Qingyun Elite Research Talent Program.

新加坡国立大学人工智能博士生，导师为 冯梦凌教授。

研究聚焦 Coding Agent 的递归自进化（RSI）与基座模型后训练：探索如何将自主探索、代码执行与可验证反馈转化为可扩展的学习信号，推动模型推理与长程任务能力的持续提升。

博士研究以 AI 递归自进化（RSI）为核心，同时研究医疗 Agent 与医疗 AI 安全，推动智能能力的进步与医疗、人类福祉的发展。

现于智谱（Z.ai）基础模型后训练团队实习，以 RSI 驱动 Coding Agent 方向的大模型后训练；同时已获阿里通义 Qwen 基座模型实习与腾讯「青云计划」精英科研人才计划。

Research 研究方向
01
Primary Focus · Coding Agent RSI 核心方向 · Coding Agent RSI

Closing the loop of AI development. 闭合 AI 研发的自进化循环。

My research pursues recursive self-improvement through Coding Agent post-training: connecting stronger agents to the development of stronger models. The long-term goal is AI that can contribute to designing, training, and evaluating its successors. 我的研究以 Coding Agent 后训练为切入点，推动递归自进化：让更强的智能体参与构建更强的模型。长期目标是让 AI 具备参与设计、训练与评估下一代 AI 的能力。

Coding Agents · Agentic Mid- & Post-Training · Verifiable RLCoding Agent · Agentic 中期训练与后训练 · 可验证强化学习

I study the training loops, rewards, and verifiers that connect better execution to better models, from long-horizon credit assignment to independent audits of agent actions.研究连接执行能力与模型进步的训练闭环、奖励机制和验证器：从长程任务的信用分配，到 Agent 行动的独立审查，让自进化建立在可检验的反馈之上。

Zhipu AI · Farsight · DivScore · OfficeBuddy 智谱 · Farsight · DivScore · OfficeBuddy
02
Research Direction · AI for Healthcare 研究方向 · AI for Healthcare

Advance intelligence. Improve human lives. 以智能的进化，推动生命的福祉。

My doctoral research explores AI for healthcare and human wellbeing. I study medical agents and medical AI safety, aiming to support clinical work with reliable reasoning, verifiable workflows, and trustworthy medical evidence. 我的博士研究围绕 AI for Healthcare 展开，以推动医疗与人类福祉为使命。聚焦医疗 Agent 与医疗 AI 安全，研究可靠推理、可验证的医疗工作流与可信医学证据，支持临床工作。

Medical Agents · Medical AI Safety医疗 Agent · 医疗 AI 安全

Medical Agents: multimodal reasoning, tool use, and verifiable medical workflows. Medical AI Safety: image integrity, interpretable forgery detection, and rigorous evaluation of agent outputs. Med-Banana and MedForge ground this direction in medical image editing and deepfake detection.医疗 Agent：多模态推理、工具调用与可验证的医疗工作流。医疗 AI 安全：医学影像真实性、可解释的伪造检测与 Agent 输出的严格评估。以 Med-Banana 的医学图像编辑和 MedForge 的医学伪造检测为具体研究支点。
